Name: Sprunyuns by Wickedy
Author: WickedyWoah
Description:
[size=5][center][b]﻿Hey, Hi, Howdy, and Hello Friends![/b][/center][/size]Wickedy here, and I have a treat for you! Or, snack rather. Ya'll know I hate spending too much time eating salmonberry after salmonberry in an early game to fill my energy, which I fixed with my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15615]Berry Snacks[/url]. Well, I also have an issue with Spring Onions. Soo helpful early on but also so much time taken out of my day eating 350 in a row to chop down a few trees. Never fear! We got [b]Sprunyuns! [/b][size=1]yay!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/vVQRRan.png[/img]
[center]*Wickedy cannot guarantee nutritional value﻿[/center]

[/size]What are Sprunyuns? Well, Spring Onion FUNYUNS of course, the stanky onion chip ring snack thing! I love Funyuns and have wanted to make this mod for a long time and finally got around to it.﻿ With Sprunyuns, you can grab some spring onions, and some fiber and CRAFT these, no cooking required. I made them available to you by default because I feel they are best used in the early game.

[b]Crafting Sprunyuns:
[/b]5 spring onions and 2 fiber to craft
+100 energy
+45 health
+2 Foraging for a little over 3 minutes.

They only sell for 100g and are not affected by Spring Onion Mastery without other mods adjusting that. Honestly, just worth it more to just eat it.

I hope you enjoy Sprunyuns!

Note: Originally had this mod with 1 wheat instead of 2 fiber, which made it not as accessible early game, so it was switched. Plus fiber is good for you!

Downloads.Description: Changed the 1 wheat to 2 fiber to make it more accessible early game. Also, who doesn't need a little more fiber in their diet, right?
